page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8163 processor cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on external network storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 32 dedicated vCPUs deliver average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Passmark, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth is average for both read and write operations on large blocks, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its balanced resource allocation and average multi-core performance, the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is suited for workloads that benefit from parallel processing but do not require high single-thread performance. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, Redis database operations, and medium-sized LLM inference tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and moderate single-core speeds position this instance as a standard general-purpose resource for non-intensive parallel computing tasks.
